description: Swap the narration of a finished video into a different voice — keeps the performance, lip-sync, and background sound. Use when the user likes the video but wants a different narrator voice; use dub_video only for language translation. Paid; returns the served URL.

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

video.description: the source video URL; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

voice.description: target narrator voice preset name, e.g. 'Aria', 'George', 'Rachel', 'Sarah', 'Brian', 'Charlotte' (defaults to a warm female read). A saved VOICE CLONE of the user's own voice counts as a preset here — name it the way it is saved on their cast

name: change_voice
title: Change narrator voice
